scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.gates:ios: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:ios
scripts.og: npm run build && (vite preview --port 4379 --strictPort & SRV=$!; sleep 2; OG_URL=http://localhost:4379/?test=1 node scripts/gen-og.mjs; kill $SRV)
scripts.shots: npm run build && (vite preview --port 4378 --strictPort & SRV=$!; sleep 2; tsx scripts/appstore-shots.ts; kill $SRV)
scripts.shots:store: npm run build && (vite preview --port 4378 --strictPort & SRV=$!; sleep 2; tsx scripts/store-shots.ts; kill $SRV)
